summary: Disney reported Q2 FY2026 on May 6: $25.17B revenue (beat $24.84B est), EPS $1.57 (beat $1.49 est). CEO Josh D'Amaro first earnings call. FY2026 EPS growth guidance raised to ~12%; FY2027 double-digit growth guided. DIS +6.24% on the day. Mandalorian and Grogu film May 22. Big Thunder Mountain reopened May 3.
